messages.subject: Rstan doesn't work since download Mac Os Sierra
parts:
Hi Coorporation

I have a problem when I download the last version of mac.

It produces 

Error in if (nchar(CXX) == 0) { : l'argument est de longueur nulle
De plus : Warning message:
l'exécution de la commande ''/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R' CMD config CXX 2>/dev/null' renvoie un statut 1 

How can I obtain the solution of this error.

Bests regards

Eric I. E.

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Rstan doesn't work since download Mac Os Sierra

On Saturday, October 22, 2016 at 9:12:41 PM UTC-4, Eric Innocents EBOULET wrote:
How can I obtain the solution of this error.
Make sure you have Xcode for Sierra installed and open it once to accept its license agreement.
